summary: Unconditional texture-object constructor: runs a DirectX texture/mipmap-chain base init on this with size 0x10 and count 1, then overwrites the vtable pointer at this[0] with off_5ADC8C and returns this.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0x10u, 1) to perform base initialization with a 0x10-byte unit size and a chain count of 1.

unresolved: Meaning of a2 (second texture-creation argument) is caller-supplied and unknown here.
Object class implied by vtable off_5ADC8C is not named in the packet.
Relationship to the sibling constructor (same helper, different size and vtable) is not evidenced.
